scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: if [ -n "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT" ] && [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env" ] && [ ! -e .env ]; then cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env" .env; fi && npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund && if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose up -d --no-recreate; else docker compose up -d --no-recreate; fi
